artists.biography: Dhani Harrison (born 1 August 1978) is a British multi-instrumentalist musician, composer and singer-songwriter (and the only child of George Harrison and his second wife, Olivia. His musical projects include thenewno2 with Oliver Hecks, and Fistful of Mercy with Joseph Arthur and Ben Harper. Read more on Last.fm. Dhani Harrison.biography: Dhani Harrison (born 1 August 1978) is a British multi-instrumentalist musician, composer and singer-songwriter (and the only child of George Harrison and his second wife, Olivia. His musical projects include thenewno2 with Oliver Hecks, and Fistful of Mercy with Joseph Arthur and Ben Harper. Read more on Last.fm.
